economy.zh:
今日全球市场在多重冲击下剧烈波动。特朗普政府以强迫劳动为由对80多个国家加征约10%的全球关税，取代此前被最高法院否决的旧关税，引发贸易伙伴强烈反弹。与此同时，中东冲突升级推动油价突破100美元/桶，美股在长期无视地缘风险后终于承压回落。欧洲方面，欧洲央行按兵不动，但官员为9月加息打开大门，因能源价格飙升推高通胀预期。中国A股午后虽逆转部分跌幅，但早盘超4900只个股下跌，市场情绪脆弱。此外，Intel因AI业务推动收入创近15年最快增长而大涨；中国最大内存芯片商CXMT启动IPO引发资金抽血担忧。

- [Trump's new global tariff draws rebukes from trade partners](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/trump-global-tariffs-trade-imbalance-forced-labor.html) 美国对60个贸易伙伴加征关税，中国、欧盟等表示拒绝接受其“强迫劳动”理由，但多数仍愿谈判。
- [U.S. to see higher generic drug prices thanks to tariffs](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/us-to-see-higher-generic-drug-prices-on-tariffs-indian-pharma-ceo.html) 印度药企Dr Reddy's CEO警告，关税将推高美国仿制药价格，影响患者。
- [Shortsighted stock market can no longer brush off war](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/short-sighted-stock-market-can-no-longer-brush-off-war-investors-say.html) 油价突破100美元后美股周四重挫，此前市场对美伊战事持续无视。
- [ECB opens door to September rate hike as Mideast conflict flares up](https://news.google.) 欧央行利率维持2.25%，但胡塞武装开辟第二石油咽喉，9月加息可能性上升。
- [Intel's stock jumps as chipmaker rides AI boom to fastest revenue growth in almost 15 years](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/intel-intc-earnings-report-q2-2026.html) 英特尔Q2业绩远超预期，AI需求推动营收增速创近15年最高，股价大涨。
- [China's largest memory chipmaker sparks fears of a cash drain as it readies for public debut](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/cxmt-china-ipo-listing-chip-memory.html) 长鑫存储（CXMT）IPO或从A股吸走大量资金，市场担忧流动性。
- [A股午评：创业板指大幅缩量跌1.78% 全市场超4900家个股下跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBxdG9ZS204Nnl0Q0t5TVhpR3VqZG1NWVZoMWZpeG9TOFUzcWh2bjlXdjdPaEpkUmlqNXBxbzRqV1FEdkYtTDZIdFdPNkpHNEJHZkVVMmtJa0REcV9IWmc) 早盘市场恐慌蔓延，仅少数板块逆势，午后随科技股抛压缓和收复部分失地。

**后续观察：** 特朗普关税的落地细节与各国反制措施将对全球贸易流产生深远影响，尤其关注下周美国最高法院可能介入的后续发展。油价若持续高于100美元，将迫使各央行重新评估通胀路径，ECB 9月加息几乎成为定局，而美联储仍处观望。中国方面，CXMT的募资规模与市场承接力将测试A股在外部冲击下的韧性。

society.zh:
今日社会新闻板块呈现三条主线：**菲尔兹奖得主邓煜的知乎答主身份引爆中文社区**，折射出知识平台与学术圈的深度交融；**国际地缘政治持续震荡**，乌克兰内部分歧、美伊战争阴影与沙特核交易交织；**气候与民生危机并行**，法国山火迫使2万人疏散，印尼跨境婴贩案引发法律与伦理拷问。跨信源对照显示，美国对60国加征关税与红海油轮动向正形成连锁反应。

- [邓煜荣膺“数学界诺奖” 知乎诞生“土生土长”的菲尔兹奖答主](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQeDRkWEVtT3lvakRTQS1FX1IydlREclZsb3BVZGhaYXFBeDh4YXVBdTQ2UldzMmlHSVlKamNxYmlTd3daaGJRVktYNF9aMElVUGFHa1dGQWdYVi1Zd29YWjZYSXBNRkpPOTQzQzAxYU00ZTN6X3ZxVE53NFN1Zk1OUWctWjNXQkpZ) ——邓煜的跨圈层身份引发“知乎如何成为科研人根据地”的反思，其日常发帖（磕CP、写物理诗）与学术成就的反差被热议。

- [Ukraine's ousted defence minister insists on being reinstated](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce97nm53pgxo) 与 [Zelenskyy meets with far-right US activist Laura Loomer](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/ukraine-zelenskyy-meets-with-trump-ally-laura-loomer) 共同显示乌克兰内部权力博弈加剧，且泽连斯基寻求美国右翼势力支持，或为对冲援乌分歧。

- [France evacuates 20,000 as wildfires spread in south-west](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy4kmr82n44o) ——阿尔卡雄湾营火旅游区游客为主，折射极端天气对旅游经济的直接冲击。

- [Israel bombs Gaza after displacement orders, kills two Palestinians](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/israel-bombs-gaza-after-displacement-orders-kills-two-palestinians) 叠加联合国“绝望”评估，显示停火协议名存实亡。

- [U.S. to impose new tariffs of up to 12.5 pct on 60 trading partners](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBCRUtVeGl5cy05YnJhVi02QnBkTS1Uel9NWkc0N1B2akhxYjZRcHRnVUFwRUNzQVFnZ05KenVNdWl5c01jR0Y5SGF1cmF6SEtRRjBYMzJlbHdOMkJWSE1mNTJuZHEtOHdOelBmTEs1czlhQW5ERjNj) 与 [As oil soars, experts watch Red Sea tankers](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/24/as-oil-soars-experts-watch-red-sea-tankers-for-clarity-on-houthi-blockade) 联动——关税叠加胡塞武装封锁红海，全球供应链压力或进一步上升。

- [Indonesian babies were trafficked to Singapore](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c7vgeredvlgo) ——至少12名婴儿被跨国贩运，法律归属与后续安置成焦点。

**后续观察**：菲尔兹奖效应将持续发酵，知乎社区能否将流量转化为商业化（其2025年营收下滑23.6%）；美伊战争拨款案在国会走向将决定中东局势拐点；法国山火若持续可能引发旅游旺季退订潮。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been marked by intensifying geopolitical conflicts, significant trade policy shifts, environmental crises, and a remarkable intellectual milestone celebrated within China's online community. The intertwined nature of war, diplomacy, and economics continues to shape global stability, while a Fields Medal win by a prominent Zhihu user highlights the growing intersection of elite science and social media culture.

- **Ukraine's internal rift deepens** as ousted Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov refuses President Zelensky's offer of an alternative post, signaling a high-stakes power struggle ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce97nm53pgxo)). Simultaneously, Zelensky met far-right US activist Laura Loomer, a Trump ally who claims Russia is helping Iran kill US soldiers ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/ukraine-zelenskyy-meets-with-trump-ally-laura-loomer)). This dual dynamic complicates Ukraine's war funding prospects in the US Congress.
- **Israel's renewed bombardment of Gaza** after issuing displacement orders has killed two Palestinians, with the UN describing the humanitarian situation as 'desperate' ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/israel-bombs-gaza-after-displacement-orders-kills-two-palestinians)). These violations of the ceasefire threaten broader regional stability.
- **US tariffs escalate** as the Trump administration imposes levies of up to 12.5% on 60 trading partners over forced labor concerns, including a 12.5% tariff on Australian exports ([Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBCRUtVeGl5cy05YnJhVi02QnBkTS1Uel9NWkc0N1B2akhxYjZRcHRnVUFwRUNzQVFnZ05KenVNdWl5c01jR0Y5SGF1cmF6SEtRRjBYMzJlbHdOMkJWSE1mNTJuZHEtOHdOelBmTEs1czlhQW5ERjNj) and [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/jul/24/australia-news-live-jim-chalmers-anthony-albanese-labor-conference-gas-tax-gambling-reform-one-nation-pauline-hanson-ntwnfb)). This widens the trade conflict and pressures global supply chains.
- **France evacuates 20,000** as wildfires rage in the Gironde region, mostly tourists from campsites around Arcachon Bay ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy4kmr82n44o)). The event underscores the growing impact of climate-related disasters on summer travel.
- **Fields Medal winner Deng Yu**, a top answerer on Zhihu, has ignited discussions about the platform's role in fostering scientific talent and its commercial challenges ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQeDRkWEVtT3lvakRTQS1FX1IydlREclZsb3BVZGhaYXFBeDh4YXVBdTQ2UldzMmlHSVlKamNxYmlTd3daaGJRVktYNF9aMElVUGFHa1dGQWdYVi1Zd29YWjZYSXBNRkpPOTQzQzAxYU00ZTN6X3ZxVE53NFN1Zk1OUWctWjNXQkpZ)). His wide range of hobbies (Go, anime, poetry) humanizes the archetype of a mathematician and has gone viral.
- **Japan's Prime Minister claims** she runs the country on just three hours of sleep, sparking debate about governance capacity and health ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE53NVNLUTVlY05EWjRrU2NqN0xvSHlwY09IcXV4Q2dMWjBkSFlxTnpUUExMc3ZGWkVBeDRpVzdqVFRRelpmVHB1eUZ1NFNOTEJ1U3d6QVdnTQ)).
- **Elon Musk**, in an interview with The Economist, said 'let's enjoy the ride' regarding AI fears and dismissed accusations of racism, reflecting the tech elite's defiant stance on regulation ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gkxppljpyo)).

**Watch next:** The Houthi blockade impact on oil prices as tanker movements are scrutinized ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/24/as-oil-soars-experts-watch-red-sea-tankers-for-clarity-on-houthi-blockade)); the US Congress vote on Iran war funding; and the fallout from Japan's steel dumping findings on East Asian trade ties.

military.zh:
今日军事新闻聚焦三大战线：中东-伊朗冲突持续升级，美国向英国费尔福德基地部署EA-37B电子战飞机，并大规模集结兵力，伊朗顾问称特朗普“绝望”，科威特拦截导弹、油价破百；台海方向，解放军在台湾海峡进行两日实弹军演，美国众议院通过NDAA要求推动台湾参与RIMPAC，卢比奥再批中国“破坏稳定”；RIMPAC 2026沉船演习（SINKEX）创下多项纪录，盟军用直升机发射至少四种导弹击沉两艘退役战舰，反舰能力显著增强。此外，俄罗斯威胁加强黑海船只攻击，乌克兰粮食出口通道面临窒息；澳大利亚紧急拼凑混合防空武器；印度海军服役第二艘马赫级反潜舰，新加坡第二艘多用途战舰下水。

- [美向英国费尔福德基地部署EA-37B，伊朗威胁攻击该基地](https://www.twz.com/air/ea-37bs-arrive-at-raf-fairford-as-iran-threatens-to-attack-the-uk-air-base)
- [解放军在台海举行两天实弹军演](https://news.google.)
- [RIMPAC SINKEX：直升机成主角，盟军展示多型反舰导弹](https://www.twz.com/news-features/helicopters-just-took-center-stage-in-rim-of-the-pacific-sinking-exercises)
- [美陆军数十年来首次采购老式PAC-2爱国者导弹](https://www.twz.com/land/u-s-army-is-buying-older-pac-2-patriot-missiles-for-the-first-time-in-decades)
- [俄罗斯将加强黑海船只攻击，泽连斯基警告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE0zcjF3VE5QN0UxaFFzMmR0N09ZMklXUW5fR0ZfYTAtcGVLbUxYcnBZblFpdXRMd2tXMVBMNVozM19FTVhoNGxOTkdsMml6d21TU2ZZ)
- [美国众议院通过2027财年NDAA，要求推动台湾参与RIMPAC](https://news.google.)
- [伊朗顾问称特朗普“绝望”，科威特拦截导弹，油价破百](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQNGVPdmR3T1c5ZkVnVi1jZGZMbURLVEZsZDJYOEJNeG56dUlhSHVqeE1pNHRoVFJLZ1puc3AzRVVoN0xqNG9ib21sZlBjN2dJSEpkNk1MdW85c1RmYk9RTi1IWGpJeU10eTJnMWFkMXBxSk1rcEJ6ZE1Remx2MGpObWRmTERNVUJOMGRzODgtQWlhYmlabURVSmIwczhpQjRZM2JiTkhfZ1VkMEdUUENIczBTN1YwLUVveEhDcmNvdlk0N00)

**后续观察**：中东局势仍是最大风险变量，伊朗威胁攻击英国基地和美国增兵可能引发直接冲突；台海因军演和NDAA升温，但中美外交层面（王毅马尼拉讲话）仍留对话窗口；RIMPAC 2026展示了盟军多域反舰能力的跃升，尤其是直升机远程打击手段，值得跟踪后续实战化部署。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by the culmination of the RIMPAC 2026 sinking exercise, which showcased a dramatic expansion in allied anti-ship capabilities, and an escalating crisis in the Middle East as the US reinforces its posture against Iran. Meanwhile, China conducted live-fire exercises in the Taiwan Strait, prompting sharp diplomatic reactions, and the Houthis resumed attacks on Saudi tankers. The ASEAN security forum in Vientiane became a stage for great-power messaging on these flashpoints.

- **RIMPAC SINKEX Demonstrates Allied Firepower**: Two decommissioned US warships—cruiser USS *Mobile Bay* and amphibious assault ship USS *Peleliu*—were sunk off Hawaii in a multi-domain sinking exercise. Allied helicopters fired at least four different missile types, while HIMARS, Type 12, LRASM, and submarine-launched Harpoon strikes were also employed ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/helicopters-just-took-center-stage-in-rim-of-the-pacific-sinking-exercises), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/rimpac-2026-sinkex-allied-anti-ship-missile-strikes/), [USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/23/video-decommissioned-uss-mobile-bay-uss-peleliu-sunk-in-rimpac-drills)).
- **US Military Buildup Against Iran**: EA-37B electronic warfare aircraft have arrived at RAF Fairford as Iran threatens to attack the UK air base. US forces are massing across the Middle East, with Rubio warning Iran’s “price will rise nightly” ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/ea-37bs-arrive-at-raf-fairford-as-iran-threatens-to-attack-the-uk-air-base), [Ynetnews](https://www.ynetnews.com/article/r1c3d4e5f6)). Oil prices have topped $100 after Kuwait intercepted missiles and an Iranian adviser called Trump “desperate” ([Türkiye Today](https://www.turkiyetoday.com/...)).
- **US Army Buys Older PAC-2 Patriots**: For the first time in decades, the US Army is purchasing PAC-2 GEM-T missiles to replenish depleted stocks, signaling a critical missile inventory crunch ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/land/u-s-army-is-buying-older-pac-2-patriot-missiles-for-the-first-time-in-decades)).
- **China Conducts Two-Day Live-Fire Drills in Taiwan Strait**: The PLA announced and executed live-fire exercises in the Taiwan Strait, drawing condemnation from Taiwan and a statement from Rubio calling it “destabilizing” ([VOA](https://www.voanews.com/...), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/...), [Radio-Canada](https://ici.radio-canada.ca/...)). The drills occurred alongside a visit by Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to Manila.
- **US House NDAA Seeks Taiwan Inclusion in RIMPAC**: The House-passed 2027 National Defense Authorization Act includes a requirement to develop a plan for Taiwan’s participation in future RIMPAC exercises, a move that will further roil Beijing ([VOA](https://www.voanews.com/...)).
- **Houthis Claim Attacks on Saudi Oil Tankers**: The Houthi movement said it struck two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea, exacerbating maritime security risks and pushing oil above $100 a barrel ([Spectrum News](https://www.spectrumlocalnews.com/...)).
- **Russia Intensifies Black Sea Blockade**: President Zelensky warned that Russia will step up attacks on vessels in the Black Sea, effectively choking Ukraine’s vital export corridor ([Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/...), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/...)).
- **ASEAN Forum Dominated by Security Crises**: The ASEAN foreign ministers’ meeting was consumed by the Middle East crisis and South China Sea tensions. Rubio reassured allies the US is not abandoning the region ([Arise News](https://www.arise.tv/...), [StratNews Global](https://www.stratnewsglobal.com/...), [The Detroit News](https://www.detroitnews.com/...)).

**Watch next:** The next 48 hours will test whether the US-Iran “skirmish” escalates further, especially after the arrival of EA-37Bs at Fairford. Markets will monitor oil supply disruptions from Red Sea attacks and the Dow’s profit warning. The outcome of RIMPAC 2026 will shape allied naval and air power integration for the year ahead.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现出监管收紧、企业战略调整与开源社区回归理性的多重信号。欧盟依据数字市场法案对Google开出10亿美元罚单，FCC主席对言论自由的攻击引发抗议；Patreon裁员20%反映内容平台在AI冲击下的成本重构；而Hacker News社区则热议Plex的商业化侵蚀、ATProto的去中心化愿景以及AI伦理的悲观预测。

* [Patreon裁员20%](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/patreon-lays-off-off-20-of-its-workforce/)：CEO称核心业务强劲但需调整成本结构，同时公司正试图保护创作者免受AI影响，但AI确实在改变商业模式。
* [欧盟重罚Google 10亿美元](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/google-hit-with-1-billion-in-fines-as-eu-braces-for-trump-battle/)：依据数字市场法案，Google成为第三个面临巨额罚款的科技巨头，正值欧盟准备与美国新政府博弈。
* [FCC主席威胁广播公司](https://www.theverge.com/policy/970284/brendan-carr-fcc-chairman-first-amendment)：Brendan Carr利用职权压制嘲讽特朗普的媒体，被批为对第一修正案的战争。
* [LG显示器通过Windows Update安装McAfee广告](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/microsoft-responds-to-lg-monitors-installing-mcafee-ads-on-windows/)：微软已介入调查，暴露硬件厂商利用系统更新推送广告的隐患。
* [AMD发布Helios AI机架系统](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/amd-takes-on-nvidia-with-its-helios-ai-rack-scale-system/)：直接挑战Nvidia，将于今年晚些时候发货，AI硬件竞争白热化。
* [Hacker News：Plex用户转向Jellyfin](https://reprodev.com/the-corporate-creep-of-plex-why-it-may-be-time-to-move-to-jellyfin-and-the-open-source-reality/)：商业侵蚀导致社区流失，43分讨论反映用户对封闭平台的反思。
* [丰田警告“无法生存”](https://electrek.co/2026/07/23/toyota-warns-cannot-survive-bets-on-next-gen-corolla-ev/)：传统巨头押注电动Corolla，全球最畅销车型的电动化转型成为生死存亡之战。
* [Tesla股价下跌](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/texas-brief/tesla-profit-falls-well-short-of-expectations-as-costs-rise-3)：财报利润远低于预期，AI支出与Robotaxi前景引发投资者担忧。

**后续观察**：欧盟与美国科技监管对抗加剧，中国新能源车企（BYD、小鹏）加速欧洲布局，传统车企被迫加速电动化。AI领域，开源模型与商业壁垒的博弈持续，Hacker News社区对“AI末日论”持结构化分析态度。下周需关注Google与欧盟的后续回应、AMD Helios的实际性能，以及Patreon裁员对创作者生态的长期影响。

sports.en:
The past 24 hours in sports have been dominated by major football transfers and managerial shifts, headlined by Manchester City's record signing of Elliot Anderson and Arsenal's £70m bid for Bruno Guimaraes. In China, the basketball world is buzzing over Zhu Fangyu's departure as Guangdong Southern Tigers GM after three consecutive CBA titles, while badminton fans celebrated Chen Yufei's dramatic comeback at the China Open. The Commonwealth Games opened in Glasgow with a royal Tardis entrance, and darts sensation Luke Littler continued his relentless form in Blackpool. Key narratives include power struggles in football management, the ripple effects of Chinese basketball restructuring, and rising stars across multiple sports.

- **Football Transfer Frenzy**: Manchester City have broken their transfer record to sign 23-year-old England midfielder Elliot Anderson for £116m, a move that reshapes the Premier League title race. Meanwhile, Arsenal are preparing a £70m offer for Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes, signaling a major midfield overhaul. [Manchester City record signing](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1eyjvzeg8qo) | [Arsenal bid](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cpq8lpj530po)
- **Managerial Carousel**: Italy's national team held talks with Carlo Ancelotti before opening discussions with Pep Guardiola, a significant indicator of Italy's ambition. Jermain Defoe left his first managerial role at Woking after just four months, calling it an 'eye-opening experience'. [Italy approach Ancelotti](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c36d0291z6no) | [Defoe leaves Woking](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c304d47ql6jo)
- **Manchester United's Teenage Prospect**: 15-year-old JJ Gabriel received a senior call-up for Manchester United's friendly against Rosenborg, highlighting the club's continued investment in youth. [JJ Gabriel call-up](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce85j3mgl06o)
- **Commonwealth Games Opener**: King Charles III emerged from a Tardis, and the Loch Ness Monster appeared on stage during a spectacular opening ceremony in Glasgow, marking the start of the 2026 Commonwealth Games. [Opening ceremony](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cvg79z237yvo)
- **Luke Littler's Dominance**: The world number one darts player continued his Matchplay title defence with a 16-7 win over Josh Rock, averaging an astonishing 109.57. Littler's form is described as 'frightening', with a nine-darter merely a footnote. [Littler win](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/darts/articles/cg5lylz22gmo) | [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13566484/luke-littler-dazzles-in-blackpool-as-frightening-world-darts-matchplay-form-continues-good-luck-to-dirk)
- **Chen Yufei's Epic Comeback in Badminton**: At the 2026 China Open, Chen Yufei saved four match points to reverse Saina Nehwal, advancing to the quarterfinals in a 90-minute thriller. Chinese shuttlers achieved 12 wins and 2 losses on the second day. [Chen Yufei comeback](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOejR1ZF9nOHFTdVhmYXJodTlic0pNNHBpWEZpbzl5dUs0bnlycEEtSWk5S0Vic0ZRSTdFRFNTd3JTUDJ1Z05KeDZ3TDhfRGhtOHNYREVMM3czNEhNak54bFdpaF82a2hma0lYbHlybHB3UThhNTZKRmlFeUJZdWRtdnFmaGxSN1FOWXpOWHpqbFE) | [Three-game battle](https://news.google.)
- **Zhu Fangyu Leaves Guangdong Southern Tigers**: After three consecutive CBA championships as GM, Zhu Fangyu has stepped down from his role at Guangdong Southern Tigers, with reports linking him to an NBL team GM position. Media commentary highlights his immense contributions to Chinese basketball. [Zhu Fangyu departure](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQOEZGVElKd1VyaE5TNExZY1dPZWNnMkVwcWxyLUEtZ2IyTlRzQXZLemg2eXA0azR2U3lqR3k2eEVIaW9lMk5GUjNlOVlGS2hYcEd4Q1lmWjVydngxbVFmenZ4ODNNNzh3cXhkSEZlQTV2UDJFZ3ZNSnZDYVJXTWgtNDR4UUE) | [Media praise](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1aeDVDcjZSRDVWZUtBaWdvY29TWU9VQ2hET3I2cDlSa1JXYzVldmhfdzNxbzBiWnp6bDBZc0dIVkIzalpyMG51X1NvZl9UN0k)
- **James to Miami Rumors Resurface**: Former NBA player Deron Williams suggested on a show that LeBron James might return to the Miami Heat, citing Miami's sunny weather compared to Cleveland's cold. This speculative comment has ignited fan discussions on Chinese platforms. [Deron Williams on James](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE53OUh5Ukd5VVNtVXNtQjFfaDVvMW4xSHYzTGhBRkE5a28yZEJpTUdZX1E2eTBwM2MxQ0VTR3FpZkhadzZrV3QwamdJeklnVWVIeUItVVBvc1hySngwNThEaU9rbw)

**Watch Next**: The Hungarian Grand Prix this weekend could see a resurgent Ferrari with Lewis Hamilton, while the 3M Open golf tournament continues with Scottie Scheffler in contention. Football fans should monitor the Bruno Guimaraes saga and Aston Villa's Champions League preparations. The badminton China Open quarterfinals will feature Chen Yufei seeking further glory.

entertainment.zh:
今日国际娱乐圈消息密度极高，既有**老牌影星母亲离世**、**巨星演唱会因声带问题中断**的突发事件，也有**Charli XCX引领后‘Brat’时代**的专辑发布，与**D4vd案件**中令人不寒而栗的庭审细节。亚洲方面，**[ifeye曼谷演唱会最后一刻取消](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857083wpp/ifeyes-bangkok-concert-cancelled-at-last-minute)** 搅动粉丝情绪，而**中国首部AI长片获证上线爱奇艺**则标志着影视产业的新节点。微博社区依然热力不减，从**鞠婧祎的齐刘海反差萌**到**张凌赫“被喊老公”梗**，话题不断出圈。

- **Chris Anne Affleck去世**：奥斯卡影帝Ben和Casey Affleck的母亲因胰腺癌去世，享年83岁。好莱坞影坛两位兄弟的“幕后推手”离场，触动行业对其家族传奇的回顾。[The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/chris-anne-affleck-dead-ben-affleck-casey-affleck-mother-1236655678/)
- **Jon Bon Jovi因声带感染中断MSG演唱会**：演出仅进行两小时后，主唱坦诚“你们得不到最好的我”，承诺改期。这已是巡演第二周，暴露了高强度巡演对老牌歌手嗓音的考验。[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jon-bon-jovi-abruptly-ends-msg-show-vocal-issues-reschedule-1237002327/) / [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bon-jovi-abruptly-ends-msg-concert-sinus-infection-1235598245/)
- **Charli XCX第七张专辑《Music, Fashion, Film》上线**：被乐评视为“Brat”时代后的转型之作，她自己称“重复做同样的事没有创作回报”。[Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/charli-xcx-new-album-music-fashion-film-here-1235597706/)
- **D4vd庭审曝出骇人细节**：法庭聆讯中，歌手被指订购尸袋、电锯和充气泳池以处理一名少女尸体，家属称这是“最可怕的噩梦”。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4g4lyze30vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **韩国流行乐队ifeye曼谷演唱会临时取消**：主办方归咎于“组织方情况”，距离演出仅剩一天，引发退票与信任危机。[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857083wpp/ifeyes-bangkok-concert-cancelled-at-last-minute)
- **中国首部AI长片获准在爱奇艺上线**：该事件被解读为AI影视从实验走向规范化、产业化的关键一步。[手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1xOTN3QWd4RmRvY1JLTzNlVGNiMnlfT1NtV01LOURjUm1zYW1HZHlaQVV1NGRuT3BkOENES0dxSUpiZFRkRU1CemczMWhYVVFHMjdGMGVqZFR0XzNHWmItQi1R)

**后续观察**：Bon Jovi若不能快速恢复，恐影响后续巡演信心；D4vd案件将长期吸引公众关注；Charli XCX的转型能否捕获主流听众值得继续追踪。国内AI长片的上线或刺激更多平台跟进，但内容质量与伦理争议仍是焦点。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment news landscape on July 24, 2026, is marked by concert disruptions, major album releases, and a wave of K-drama premieres and variety shows. Notable events include Jon Bon Jovi's abrupt MSG show cancellation, Charli XCX's post-Brat album drop, and the ifeye Bangkok concert cancellation. Meanwhile, the K-drama scene is abuzz with teasers for "New Recruit 4" and "A Bona Fide Killer," while Chinese entertainment sees the debut of the nation's first AI feature film and a heated debate over celebrity participation in a racing event. Social media is dominated by viral moments from idols like Zhang Linghe, Cheng Yi, and Ju Jingyi.

- **Jon Bon Jovi** abruptly ended his Madison Square Garden concert on July 23 due to a sinus infection, promising rescheduled dates. [Source](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jon-bon-jovi-abruptly-ends-msg-show-vocal-issues-reschedule-1237002327/)
- **Charli XCX** released her seventh album "Music, Fashion, Film," following her brat summer era, with Rolling Stone noting her aversion to repeating herself. [Source](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/charli-xcx-releases-music-fashion-film-album-1236655613/) / [Source](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/charli-xcx-new-album-music-fashion-film-here-1235597706/)
- South Korean director **Na Hong-Jin** made his Comic-Con debut with alien action film "Hope" starring Hoyeon, calling her casting his "best decision." [Source](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/na-hong-jin-comic-con-hope-footage-hoyeon-1236819530/)
- K-pop group **ifeye**’s Bangkok concert was cancelled last-minute due to organizer-side issues, disappointing fans. [Source](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857083wpp/ifeyes-bangkok-concert-cancelled-at-last-minute)
- K-drama **"New Recruit 4"** unveiled its first poster and teaser, continuing the black comedy about military life with returning cast members. [Source](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856922wpp/watch-kim-min-ho-kim-dong-jun-kim-hyun-kyu-and-more-return-for-another-round-of-military-life-in-new-recruit-4-teaser)
- China’s first AI-generated feature film received approval for release on iQiyi, marking a milestone in AI影视规范化 and industrialization. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1xOTN3QWd4RmRvY1JLTzNlVGNiMnlfT1NtV01LOURjUm1zYW1HZHlaQVV1NGRuT3BkOENES0dxSUpiZFRkRU1CemczMWhYVVFHMjdGMGVqZFR0XzNHWmItQi1R)
- Weibo trends saw **Zhang Linghe**’s shy "husband" reaction, **Cheng Yi**’s pun-based viral moments, and **Ju Jingyi**’s contrasting cute-and-fierce styling. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFA5YWdYNlBNNG9WX3g3RldrNUZBQndMR3NCWFNBVFVKVE45dFAzQjVzU0h1NE91dnE2SnZPZ1RMZHFmYm5RaEN5QXJlY3I5aTFiZzVpeHFRT0FXcEVqS0Fwa0tfVXRXQ1lCMUJGcWt3TjM) / [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBzZFJkcURjMGprRTRDWDRwdGR1WW16eXllR3JxamZLQktieWVSX19yTkRLZG1vUkFQd1BaSThvalpBMHNRdl9XcVdqcE5pMWdiSVQxaEdoOTRXakw1U0VTVHBMZ1dQd25qd01BOXpLbzM) / [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1hc3ZXX0FHYlktWUxDWTlacHZGVVk5R3htdlFfSDQxM1N5MGEtRWQ3TWJPcFgzYU5LNFRYM0g1QVRRSVdhMXJuTnhDY3AtQkwwVWdfM2MxQjZvMTVvOVBFM0NJbWZiZV9ab2hQVmwxTHZxQQ)
- The 74th Miss World China finals concluded with Yan Jiexin empowering women. [Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1tcXNCLWtUQTh0MkdwZDRiT09wbk8wWW1ES2JEcXYzSE8tdEF3Z1RyR1JEX1RUYWVnLXNmNVhWdFpvclEtQUYtQk5BUEZHUUd4V3dvMU11dUN0Z0k)

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on the aftermath of Bon Jovi's vocal issues, the box office performance of "Resident Evil" and "Hope," and the Chinese AI film's reception. Also monitor the viral trends from Chinese variety and idols as they continue to dominate Weibo.

美股.zh:
美股在连续多日无视地缘风险后终于回调，因油价突破100美元且特朗普宣布新一轮全球关税。Intel凭借AI业务交出15年来最强营收增速，成为科技股中的亮点。Oracle赢得五角大楼70亿美元10年合同，显示国防科技支出韧性。

- [Trump’s Global Tariffs: What’s the Latest on the Trade War](https://www.nytimes.com/article/trump-tariffs-trade.html) 新关税体系取代旧版，最高法院曾推翻原案，此次法律挑战将再起。
- [U.S., other nations back open-source AI with 'strong security' at China summit](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/china-ai-open-source-apec.html) APEC部长级声明首次纳入开源AI合作，中美在AI治理上罕见达成共识。
- [Intel's stock jumps as chipmaker rides AI boom](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/intel-intc-earnings-report-q2-2026.html) 英特尔Q2营收同比增28%，数据中心芯片收入翻倍，AI服务器需求是核心驱动力。
- [Oracle signs 10-year software contract with Pentagon worth up to $7 billion](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/oracle-wins-10-year-pentagon-software-contract-worth-up-to-7-billion.html) 甲骨文将为国防部提供本地部署软件，合同金额上限70亿美元。

**收束判断：** 美国经济基本面仍具韧性，但关税与油价双重供给冲击正在压缩企业利润空间，科技股估值面临修正压力。

欧洲经济.zh:
欧央行在通胀与战争双重压力下维持利率2.25%不变，但明确释放9月加息信号，因胡塞武装袭击红海油轮造成“第二石油咽喉”危机。英国FTSE 100回落，德国DAX下跌，债券收益率攀升。

- [ECB reveals shortlisted designs for new banknotes and launches public survey](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260723~c2d43f9170.en.html) 新版纸币设计公开征求意见，象征意义大于经济影响，但显示欧央行致力于公众沟通。
- [ECB Holds as Houthis Open a Second Oil Chokepoint: What September Will Decide](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxNX0d0S2F1NzZ3SDNtUzJsZUxIZ3pscFJYd04wNkxSQWtXLU9xeUNiUEVQamxZakQzQVJhRE54dW41U0tyb2xKeTJhallreUVEZTBqMnBxS2pIZURDU2J0NUtmMEY1MVJ1QmkyaDZfZE4yTF9XSnJBU0w2ZzFnMmdVeEdfYXJObTdNU3otSDFlU2lhQmQtSEV5LTZHWEpvZ3NXS2dlUjl4R1dYVWk5eFRHOVFqZTJ2QUNMOG1IVU1zempSZ2lW) 欧央行关注能源价格飙升对核心通胀的二次效应。
- [UK's FTSE 100 slips as oil tops $100 on Middle East conflict; bond yields rise](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQc1JkUDltQlFteDFRQ29SNGEyYy1yZWhrVU52R3YwMVFycTZ0aWk1bFhkeVo1cENmU21IZFlVeDhJTWR1TWFHVDhnT0NUV29FUUlLV1J6a1FFUjhXZXhITlpKenBTckpYT19IWGgzVDRYakFOT04ySlplVVpHWF9ZS3ZYWkVYVzhsbExkWXpPWFZJRnhRbE5pUV9vOFpDMGc4Yk5QNlVLZGtETTFBV0VlZW5DWQ) 英国10年期国债收益率升至4.5%，市场定价央行更激进加息。

**收束判断：** 欧洲面临输入性通胀与增长放缓的“滞胀”风险，ECB若9月加息将加剧债券市场波动，但若不行动则通胀预期脱锚。

中国经济.zh:
A股早盘大幅下挫，超4900只个股下跌，创业板指缩量跌1.78%，午后科技股抛压缓解部分反弹。香港市场方面，HSBC以20.8亿美元出售新加坡保险业务给Allianz，显示外资重组亚洲业务。CXMT（长鑫存储）IPO引发资金抽血担忧。同时，香港跨境消费同比增近30%，显示内地消费需求外溢。

- [A股午评：创业板指大幅缩量跌1.78% 全市场超4900家个股下跌](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBxdG9ZS204Nnl0Q0t5TVhpR3VqZG1NWVZoMWZpeG9TOFUzcWh2bjlXdjdPaEpkUmlqNXBxbzRqV1FEdkYtTDZIdFdPNkpHNEJHZkVVMmtJa0REcV9IWmc) 早盘恐慌情绪蔓延，仅少数防御板块上涨。
- [China's largest memory chipmaker sparks fears of a cash drain as it readies for public debut](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/24/cxmt-china-ipo-listing-chip-memory.html) CXMT拟募资规模可能超过200亿元，市场担忧抽血效应。
- [HSBC agrees to US$2 billion deal to sell Singapore insurance branch to Allianz](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3361669/hsbc-agrees-us2-billion-deal-sell-singapore-insurance-branch-allianz) 汇丰出售新加坡寿险和健康险业务，交易预计2027年上半年完成，将提升其核心一级资本充足率15个基点。
- [Rare 6-month office flip suggests Hong Kong’s prime market is stabilising](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3361655/rare-six-month-office-flip-suggests-hong-kongs-prime-market-stabilising) 金钟远东金融中心一写字楼半年转手获利19%，暗示香港优质商业地产或已触底。

**收束判断：** 中国股市短期受外部关税冲击和IPO抽血双重压制，但香港市场出现的积极信号（写字楼交易、跨境消费增长）可能为后续情绪修复提供支撑。

同花顺社区动态.zh:
同花顺社区内最受关注的是ST恒信实控人起诉公司，股东内斗公开化，提案同意率仅44%。此外，资金面显示ETF整体净流入187亿元，融资买入活跃（中际旭创买入46亿元居首），但个股普跌说明资金集中度极高。国家统计局数据显示生猪价格环比上涨0.9%，显示通胀压力温和。

- [提案同意率仅44%落败！ST恒信实控人起诉公司，股东内斗全面公开](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9HekxnWnpNR0xyOUpzVFZveFppZHNvM1dzcnIxTHlmSXR0WHdEM2JPMzZJaDNSeVRsWDF5MnRCTzloaHl4ZkFSYmtCZmlTRWVtRUZsQi1pcjBmSkxwMko0cVlR) 实控人与董事会矛盾激化，投资者担忧公司治理风险。
- [7月23日ETF资金整体净流入187.62亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE42MnpEWUpYRGF0WElpcXV4OGMwWF9OUXdtbERWVzg4M1NmWml3Vm1sMmdkdkNoZGZDYWt6eTFhWVJ6QUJ4b1Uxb3lqNVFoaXd4cHU4a3NqX0o2UWtMTXc) 在市场大跌中，资金通过ETF逆势抄底，主要流向沪深300和科创50。
- [7月23日326股获融资买入超亿元 中际旭创获买入46.46亿元居首](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1jOUdrR2FyUWloWVREc3p5UUJIQndEZ1UyT19ZMWF1bWdGZDlQYklzbDFySndjVDRjR0NIWWM0NEFpa1BJOGg4cUxVRW1ncjMtMGJtbGRyQ2xNQXY4NHc) 融资盘集中在光模块龙头，反映市场对AI算力链的赌注。
- [国家统计局：7月中旬生猪（外三元）价格环比增长0.9%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBBcjVWN3FCYXItcFRZZWhjNUpHQUpLQV9YY09tbjk5SXF0NE8tQjc4aDlDYnU0QXNueFY3a200Z3U5eDBzUi03NmVHS3AweWdZSXkxeXBBR1U1WVhBZkE) 猪肉价格温和上升，但不足以改变整体低通胀格局。

**收束判断：** 社区讨论呈现两极化——一边是退市风险股的内斗恐慌，一边是AI主线的高杠杆博弈，散户情绪脆弱但结构性机会仍聚焦科技。

欧美.zh:
乌克兰政局再现裂痕：被解职的国防部长拒绝接受替代职务，与泽连斯基陷入僵持；同时泽连斯基会见特朗普盟友、极右翼活动家Laura Loomer，其亲以色列立场或意在拉拢美国鹰派。中东方面，以色列在“停火”期间再次空袭加沙，联合国称人道状况“绝望”。法国西南部山火迫使2万游客疏散，旅游业承压。美国宣布对60个贸易伙伴加征最高12.5%关税，与红海胡塞武装封锁形成双重供给冲击，油价飙涨。跨信源印证：沙特核协议被特朗普与以色列关系捆绑，中东筹码重组。

- [Ukraine's ousted defence minister insists on being reinstated](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce97nm53pgxo)
- [Israel bombs Gaza after displacement orders](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/israel-bombs-gaza-after-displacement-orders-kills-two-palestinians)
- [France evacuates 20,000 as wildfires spread](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy4kmr82n44o)
- [U.S. to impose new tariffs of up to 12.5 pct on 60 trading partners](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBCRUtVeGl5cy05YnJhVi02QnBkTS1Uel9NWkc0N1B2akhxYjZRcHRnVUFwRUNzQVFnZ05KenVNdWl5c01jR0Y5SGF1cmF6SEtRRjBYMzJlbHdOMkJWSE1mNTJuZHEtOHdOelBmTEs1czlhQW5ERjNj)

欧美板块今日信号密集，地缘、气候、贸易三重压力叠加，投资者需警惕风险传导。
欧美.en:
Global conflicts and economic policy dominate the Western news landscape. Ukraine's leadership crisis and Gaza's escalating violence compete for attention with US tariff expansions and environmental emergencies. The interplay between war, trade, and climate is reshaping geopolitical calculations.

- **Ukraine: power struggle or strategic reshuffle?** Mykhailo Fedorov, the ousted defence minister, refuses President Zelensky's offer of an alternative post, prolonging a battle of wills that could affect war momentum ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce97nm53pgxo)). Meanwhile, Zelensky's meeting with far-right US activist Laura Loomer signals outreach to Trump-aligned circles amid uncertain US aid ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/ukraine-zelenskyy-meets-with-trump-ally-laura-loomer)).
- **Gaza ceasefire unravels** as Israel bombs areas under displacement orders, killing two Palestinians. The UN calls the humanitarian situation 'desperate', raising fears of a wider conflagration ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/24/israel-bombs-gaza-after-displacement-orders-kills-two-palestinians)).
- **US tariffs hit 60 nations** with levies up to 12.5% over forced labor allegations, affecting allies like Australia and straining global trade relations ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2026/jul/24/australia-news-live-jim-chalmers-anthony-albanese-labor-conference-gas-tax-gambling-reform-one-nation-pauline-hanson-ntwnfb) and [Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBCRUtVeGl5cy05YnJhVi02QnBkTS1Uel9NWkc0N1B2akhxYjZRcHRnVUFwRUNzQVFnZ05KenVNdWl5c01jR0Y5SGF1cmF6SEtRRjBYMzJlbHdOMkJWSE1mNTJuZHEtOHdOelBmTEs1czlhQW5ERjNj)).
- **France wildfires force 20,000 to evacuate** from Arcachon Bay campsites, a stark reminder of climate risks to summer tourism ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy4kmr82n44o)).

The confluence of conflict and policy uncertainty makes the next 48 hours critical for oil markets and congressional debates.

日韩.zh:
日本对中韩钢铁作出反倾销初步裁定，贸易摩擦升级；同期中日外长就台湾问题首次通话，显示双方外交博弈仍在胶着。日本首相自称每天只睡三小时引发公众健康讨论。韩国现代汽车二季度利润下滑但营收创新高，反映销量增长与成本挤压并存。瑞士安乐死企业负责人登富士山途中猝死，引发伦理与意外风险讨论。另，七十一便利店警告门店擅自转售角色商品，指向Z世代收藏文化的灰色市场。

- [Japan makes preliminary finding on steel dumping by South Korea, China](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNaUtULWRvTGszRTJIM2VHbl93UG9JbnVzR1JGZTR3Mmd6SUw3NFpodjIwV2lTVkFuNHVVaHdvLUhhZHR3YThPYTdpeUtPMnRFVmNqaGQ4bGpRU3hIUy0zckpXQWNVTF9jb25TVEJ2eUhFYy14RWRxOGZkSlVjNXR6aHlkY0hyeFFueWozV3JsQ1JhN2JhQ2hsaVlQOFY5QkYtZDJGbkpJQi11a3ZLY25rRERtc2lwMEdqbkFtN3Rn)
- [Japan and China’s top diplomats hold first chat since Takaichi’s Taiwan remarks](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxON3BHUHRhRnBPM09LY2xTM1BrR2tKdmtxclMzMTV4UktKbmlNaUFDN2dzcExFWDkwQ2NYck9BUWo1dkFmU2RYNWFZamlkZldvNGgwNFpsUnRoUDlMMDMwaG1fUUxkMUpFR2MtUVl0Vkc5ZXlOc250UkNaaTRKQUhEUG5sWWZleGdueEJnWg)
- [Head of Swiss euthanasia firm dies after collapsing while ascending Mount Fuji](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE9Xb3B5eERNTWRLRGJEOXMtV1Z2cFdkWURpNVFIb3plMXVvNjhidThGd3J0R3Bjdkx5MHlZcWpuSEUxZFI3NEdwem15VEFJR1NHRVVRa3N6Rm1JOEs4T3hvREd2em1iNi1ZdzREUUotS1BfZllvblNaYUNDRHRXQQ)

日韩今日贸易摩擦与经济数据分化值得追踪，中日关系走向需关注后续互动。
日韩.en:
East Asian headlines are shaped by trade friction, domestic governance quirks, and cultural exports. Japan's preliminary steel dumping finding against South Korea and China signals renewed protectionism, while softer stories reveal societal undercurrents.

- **Japan accuses South Korea and China of steel dumping**, issuing a preliminary finding that could lead to anti-dumping duties. This adds tension to already strained trade relations (Reuters via [Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNaUtULWRvTGszRTJIM2VHbl93UG9JbnVzR1JGZTR3Mmd6SUw3NFpodjIwV2lTVkFuNHVVaHdvLUhhZHR3YThPYTdpeUtPMnRFVmNqaGQ4bGpRU3hIUy0zckpXQWNVTF9jb25TVEJ2eUhFYy14RWRxOGZkSlVjNXR6aHlkY0hyeFFueWozV3JsQ1JhN2JhQ2hsaVlQOFY5QkYtZDJGbkpJQi11a3ZLY25rRERtc2lwMEdqbkFtN3Rn)).
- **Japan's PM claims three hours of sleep**, raising eyebrows about governance capacity and personal health. The statement has triggered public debate on work-life balance in politics ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE53NVNLUTVlY05EWjRrU2NqN0xvSHlwY09IcXV4Q2dMWjBkSFlxTnpUUExMc3ZGWkVBeDRpVzdqVFRRelpmVHB1eUZ1NFNOTEJ1U3d6QVdnTQ)).
- **Ainu Summer Festival opens in New York**, promoting Indigenous culture from Japan on an international stage ([News On Japan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBMS2VXdFVnaEIyR2V4SXoyd0tUaHQ2RFpDTUN2M0tGWVNBNGlXTlFNYTZUSEtHUVlvYTJ6QlRkSnM0R2FaR0h4YmN1S2xIMWsxdkt6Qg)).
- **Hyundai Motor Q2 profit falls** despite record revenue, squeezed by higher costs and competition ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE10SWI3ajZHUE9wcFVhVTNlZzBRWHJ6TWtVTS13WndGOUhNcVNVazJSWENVX0dsbW9Sc2R4LXpDUTVpQ3YyWHMxLTlQYlJOeWdSeEJ3aHFPWQ)).
- **BTS showcases custom luxury outfits** for Paris stage, underscoring K-pop's global fashion influence ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1CZkhuanpNdEdFdTJQSkhzcVlZQVJqd2NicHJGSXdsWFcwcjB0MlNOcTNyTm1SSDVYZHNnSDh0RGEwTlRlcUxJOG5IVi1EcndmVjk3S2pZZw)).

Trade friction and defense cooperation (Canada entry into fighter jet program) will be key monitors; watch Japan-China diplomat talks after Taiwan remarks.

知乎社区动态.zh:
今日知乎社区被一位“自己人”刷屏——数学家邓煜荣获菲尔兹奖，而其知乎答主身份（活跃近十年，分享围棋、动漫、写诗）让平台意外成为“造神”现场。大量用户涌入其主页围观“反差日常”，媒体追问“知乎为何能成为科研人员根据地”。与此同时，知乎2025年营收同比下降23.6%，CEO周源称将加速AI商业化探索——社区荣耀与商业困境形成戏剧性对照。

- [邓煜荣膺“数学界诺奖” 知乎诞生“土生土长”的菲尔兹奖答主](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQeDRkWEVtT3lvakRTQS1FX1IydlREclZsb3BVZGhaYXFBeDh4YXVBdTQ2UldzMmlHSVlKamNxYmlTd3daaGJRVktYNF9aMElVUGFHa1dGQWdYVi1Zd29YWjZYSXBNRkpPOTQzQzAxYU00ZTN6X3ZxVE53NFN1Zk1OUWctWjNXQkpZ)
- [数学之外的邓煜：INTJ、知乎大神、围棋、动漫、诗人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE9QOGlQVl8wRDN5LWJEMm80bjBxX2FlUE1hTGEyRDBQcU9Lb3Nra1JXRnpCX1pBLUJsX01Za05HaG9uX0d5V1EtMHRxQUs)
- [知乎2025年营收下滑23.6% CEO周源：加速对AI相关的商业化探索](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)

邓煜现象短期内或为知乎带来流量红利，但长期商业化仍面临挑战，需观察AI探索能否落地。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu is in the spotlight as Fields Medal winner Deng Yu turns out to be a prolific contributor on the platform, sparking a wave of interest in his personal hobbies and the site's role in nurturing scientific talent. Concurrently, Zhihu's declining revenue forces a pivot to AI monetization.

- **Deng Yu wins Fields Medal** and is revealed as a top Zhihu answerer, making him a 'homegrown' celebrity mathematician on the platform ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQeDRkWEVtT3lvakRTQS1FX1IydlREclZsb3BVZGhaYXFBeDh4YXVBdTQ2UldzMmlHSVlKamNxYmlTd3daaGJRVktYNF9aMElVUGFHa1dGQWdYVi1Zd29YWjZYSXBNRkpPOTQzQzAxYU00ZTN6X3ZxVE53NFN1Zk1OUWctWjNXQkpZ)).
- **His Zhihu profile reveals eclectic interests**: INTJ personality, Go, anime, poetry, creating a 'contrast' with his rigorous math research that delights users ([Phoenix](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE9QOGlQVl8wRDN5LWJEMm80bjBxX2FlUE1hTGEyRDBQcU9Lb3Nra1JXRnpCX1pBLUJsX01Za05HaG9uX0d5V1EtMHRxQUs)).
- **Zhihu's 2025 revenue dropped 23.6%**, and CEO Zhou Yuan says the company will accelerate AI-driven commercialization ([Cailianshe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)).
- **Debate emerges** on how Zhihu became a hub for researchers, contrasting with its origins as a general Q&A and entertainment community ([Sina](https://news.google.)).

The Fields Medal narrative humanizes elite science; Zhihu's financial struggles remind that community depth does not guarantee revenue.

中国.zh:
公安部发布社会稳定形势报告，称“中国式安全感”成热门话题，官方媒体同步刊发多篇相关报道。中共中央、国务院同日印发《关于加强新时代社会工作的意见》和《全民健身计划（2026-2030年）》，政策密度较大。值得关注的是，中国科协官微借邓煜获菲尔兹奖发文，称“看见科技强国的信心和力量”，将其纳入科技叙事。此外，中国援莱索托医疗队开展义诊，体现对外援助基调。

- [公安部：我国社会稳定形势持续向好 中国式安全感成热门话题](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE5TUU5laTdKUmtmbU9haU1IbzNtcHk0bDYxMGhzM2ZKRmUzYms3UHlldnB1YWE3Q0xVOXFqZ2JMMTE3ZFBGVkZRWEhoeVdKcGF5R2FuWWtzQ2JEazV5YWVwOVFiNWQzMXVV)
- [新华社消息丨中共中央、国务院印发《关于加强新时代社会工作的意见》](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQRHBKOURTOHhGc0RPcnFyZzk3cVF1WXZ6NExxUDB0azhtLVZvRFA0T2pSUzVqb3Y3YnVEOTZaa2tqcHA3Q2wzSHFBdXh4YWZhWU52ZHNac3NMcjRQc0VtTDhuOGwzbU14QTIzaTZvOGNobDhVTmxqMEJqbi1wVnppdE5IQ0NhMDFCM2Y0)
- [国务院印发《全民健身计划（2026－2030年）》](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE03dEZWcjNCZW9kbC1KeDd6Si01SUdmelhlNk9TSU40VFkzM0YxdUNGY3JrZy1KckNGSng1YkltM1R2MFNXNjBuckJJR2RlSkpHRzlvdGFIaGxTUklPVks2U0lrWXRCd21MUjl5bVd2dTBrYmRuM0Z5eEN4VkZyZw)
- [中国科协官微发文：从“菲尔茨奖”，看见科技强国的信心和力量](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE9tV0tGd2s3MTc1d0FJQTc5RlJxNmdpT2FrU1NXUG11SmQtbFdXR0thYzJ3ek5BNXZ3dy1RTGFvV0hiNjN0ZkFpUUFtSFN5dVBGbDdaMG9sWDFQTGVBZ1Y3ZA)

中国板块今日政策密集，科技与社会治理并行，官媒对菲尔兹奖的解读提示了“科技强国”叙事的统一性。
中国.en:
Chinese state media and government channels emphasize social stability, new policy directives, and national pride in scientific achievement. The Fields Medal win is reframed as evidence of technological strength, while new social work and fitness plans signal long-term governance priorities.

- **Public security ministry declares 'continuous improvement'** in social stability, with 'Chinese-style security' becoming a trending topic ([Chinanews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE5TUU5laTdKUmtmbU9haU1IbzNtcHk0bDYxMGhzM2ZKRmUzYms3UHlldnB1YWE3Q0xVOXFqZ2JMMTE3ZFBGVkZRWEhoeVdKcGF5R2FuWWtzQ2JEazV5YWVwOVFiNWQzMXVV)).
- **Central Committee and State Council issue opinion** on 'Strengthening Social Work in the New Era', a comprehensive policy document likely to shape grassroots governance ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQRHBKOURTOHhGc0RPcnFyZzk3cVF1WXZ6NExxUDB0azhtLVZvRFA0T2pSUzVqb3Y3YnVEOTZaa2tqcHA3Q2wzSHFBdXh4YWZhWU52ZHNac3NMcjRQc0VtTDhuOGwzbU14QTIzaTZvOGNobDhVTmxqMEJqbi1wVnppdE5IQ0NhMDFCM2Y0)).
- **State Council unveils National Fitness Plan 2026–2030**, emphasizing public health and sports infrastructure ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE03dEZWcjNCZW9kbC1KeDd6Si01SUdmelhlNk9TSU40VFkzM0YxdUNGY3JrZy1KckNGSng1YkltM1R2MFNXNjBuckJJR2RlSkpHRzlvdGFIaGxTUklPVks2U0lrWXRCd21MUjl5bVd2dTBrYmRuM0Z5eEN4VkZyZw)).
- **China Science and Technology Association hails Deng Yu's Fields Medal** as a sign of 'technological power' and national confidence, linking individual achievement to state narrative ([thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE9tV0tGd2s3MTc1d0FJQTc5RlJxNmdpT2FrU1NXUG11SmQtbFdXR0thYzJ3ek5BNXZ3dy1RTGFvV0hiNjN0ZkFpUUFtSFN5dVBGbDdaMG9sWDFQTGVBZ1Y3ZA)).
- **Education ministry advances** a major project on building an independent knowledge system for information resource management, reflecting push for academic sovereignty ([nju.edu.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE9ndnZuX01pWDhmTXU1VDJzVk5UYnJJX0dvazBicmloaGE5RG01RW11Z2UxWVNFYm1OTFRrNC12dXFYRTZobWpSRndxdWFqUWR2WVlLR1d3)).

These announcements reinforce a dual focus: internal stability and external prestige, with science policy as a key pillar.

国际安全.zh:
伊朗与美国对抗持续激化，特朗普称“正在赢”，但伊朗顾问反驳。美国向英国费尔福德基地部署EA-37B电子战飞机以威慑伊朗，伊朗则威胁攻击该基地。同时，美军开始采购老式PAC-2爱国者导弹以弥补库存缺口，显示防空弹药紧缺。此外，胡塞武装宣称在红海袭击两艘沙特油轮，红海航运安全再度恶化。

- [美陆军采购老式PAC-2爱国者导弹](https://www.twz.com/land/u-s-army-is-buying-older-pac-2-patriot-missiles-for-the-first-time-in-decades)
- [胡塞宣称袭击两艘沙特油轮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQelJYWEgxa0ZMM044RTZxZk9SSHN6LXo4aGtONWpOeDdmbEJRM3JSR2dLTnJTalBnVS1URUhQQU8zc2ljUk1VS3NhbS1MVlA4MlFHYTJJNjVjWTliUWxaQ2o2cFlFUmYtSTV4SmM3Z3hGeHdOdms0dlRiV2hDdjZFSlp2Zk9ub3VnWTdpYUxsd0d3VGh0X3JkTXFMOFNZM1lMSjViaGt6U3o1TXdUT3lIREEyT3lXUzluLXMtQlh4RTA)

中美伊三方博弈进入危险期，油价破百加剧全球通胀压力，需密切关注美国下一步军事选项。
国际安全.en:
The international security landscape is shaped by deepening US-ROK cooperation on integrated air and missile defense, a congressional push to block Trump-class battleship construction unless key weapons are mature, and a US Army decision to buy legacy PAC-2 Patriot missiles to address inventory shortfalls. The RIMPAC 2026 sinking exercise served as a live-fire demonstration of allied anti-ship capabilities using multiple missile systems and platforms.

- [US and South Korea Set to Conclude 7th Annual Integrated Air & Missile Defense Academy](https://www.dvidshub.net/...)
- [Congress Proposes Guardrails for Trump-Class Battleship Program; White House Pushback](https://www.twz.com/sea/congress-proposed-trump-class-battleship-program-guardrails-met-with-white-house-pushback)
- [US Army Buying Older PAC-2 Patriot Missiles for First Time in Decades](https://www.twz.com/land/u-s-army-is-buying-older-pac-2-patriot-missiles-for-the-first-time-in-decades)
- [Australia Whips Together Hybrid Air Defense Weapon](https://www.defensenews.com/...)
- [BETA Teams with GE, Sikorsky for Militarized Unmanned Aircraft](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/beta-teams-with-ge-sikorsky-for-militarized-unmanned-aircraft/)

**Signal:** The US is scrambling to replenish missile stocks and invest in hybrid capabilities even as it projects power across multiple theaters—watch for further industry announcements on rapid prototyping.

中国军情.zh:
解放军于7月23-24日在台湾海峡进行实弹军演，引发美国国务卿卢比奥和台湾方面谴责。与此同时，美国众议院通过2027财年国防授权法案，要求制定计划推动台湾参与环太军演。菲律宾则在黄岩岛海域上演“侵闯闹剧”，中方予以批驳。王毅在马尼拉强调南海“和平、稳定、合作”的主流叙事。
- [解放军在台海进行两天实弹军演](https://news.google.)
- [美众议院NDAA要求推动台湾参与RIMPAC](https://news.google.)
- [菲律宾黄岩岛侵闯闹剧被中方批驳](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1HaTg4d1lQYllDaXc3MWdvTk1WMnRiRUpKS04xYWFVb0ZJajNTdUlVdGtvZEI3aGUxUDFldHBsdHI4bldXZlRFZDFvMC1SN3d3MTg4aWFCWUNaOEJTY29lWjRpc2pnNmVodmNma0VDcHhXUQ)

台海局势因军演和立法双重升温，但外交层面仍存弹性；南海菲律宾行为短期难以改变对峙格局。
中国军情.en:
China’s military posture in the Taiwan Strait and South China Sea remains assertive, with live-fire drills in the Strait and continued pushback against Philippine activities at Scarborough Shoal. The US House NDAA’s push for Taiwan’s inclusion in RIMPAC and Washington’s renewed blacklisting of Chinese firms add new layers of strategic friction.

- [Japan Hyping Taiwan Strait, South China Sea Threats; China Rebuts](https://www.ifeng.com/...)
- [Philippines Staged Intrusion at Scarborough Shoal During International Meeting, Beijing Alleges](https://www.beijingnews.com/...)
- [US House NDAA Requires Plan for Taiwan Participation in RIMPAC](https://www.voanews.com/...)
- [China Conducts Two-Day Live-Fire Exercise in Taiwan Strait](https://www.rfi.fr/...)
- [US Blacklists Additional Chinese Firms Under “Military-Enterprise” List; Beijing Responds](https://www.cls.cn/...)

**Signal:** The combination of PLA live-fire exercises and US legislative moves to integrate Taiwan into multilateral drills points to a deliberate ratcheting of pressure on both sides of the Strait; the risk of miscalculation is rising.

冲突局势.zh:
中东危机与南海紧张主导东盟安全论坛，美国国务卿鲁比奥在马尼拉向盟友保证“不会被抛弃”。俄罗斯则宣布将加强黑海船只攻击，乌克兰粮食出口通道面临窒息，泽连斯基已与特朗普特使通话以“重振外交”。此外，陶氏化学警告中东冲突可能扰乱供应链，油价突破100美元。

两条战线（中东、黑海）的联动效应正在显现，能源与粮食安全成为全球焦点。
冲突局势.en:
Multiple concurrent conflicts are converging: the Middle East crisis dominates headlines as US forces mass against Iran, the Houthis attack Saudi tankers, and oil prices surge. Meanwhile, Russia is tightening its chokehold on Ukraine’s Black Sea export corridor, and Zelensky is seeking a diplomatic off-ramp through Trump envoys. At the ASEAN forum, foreign ministers struggled to address overlapping security emergencies.

- [Dow Forecasts Stronger Core Profit but Warns Middle East Conflict Could Disrupt Supplies](https://www.meza.news/...)
- [Rubio Uses Manila Briefing to Present Broad US Foreign Policy Agenda, Reassures Allies](https://www.kurdistan24.net/...)
- [Middle East Crisis, South China Sea Tensions Dominate ASEAN Security Forum](https://www.arise.tv/...)
- [Russia Will Step Up Attacks on Vessels in Black Sea, Zelensky Says](https://www.arabnews.com/...)
- [Zelensky Speaks to Trump Envoys to ‘Reinvigorate Diplomacy’](https://www.thedefensepost.com/...)

**Signal:** The simultaneous escalation in the Middle East and Black Sea is creating a dual energy and food supply shock; watch for coordinated Western sanctions or naval escort operations in the Red Sea and Black Sea.

海军与印太.zh:
RIMPAC 2026沉船演习成为本周亮点，退役巡洋舰“莫比尔湾”号和两栖攻击舰“贝里琉”号被击沉，盟军使用HIMARS、LRASM、鱼叉等武器展示联合作战能力。台湾接收第5艘1000吨级海岸警卫舰“澎湖”号，强化“白色船体”舰队。新加坡第二艘多用途战斗舰下水，印度海军服役第2艘马赫级反潜舰，印太海军现代化加速。
- [RIMPAC SINKEX：两舰被击沉，联盟反舰能力提升](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/rimpac-2026-sinkex-allied-anti-ship-missile-strikes/)
- [台湾接收最新海岸警卫舰“澎湖”号](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/23/taiwan-receives-latest-coast-guard-cutter-from-1-3b-fleet-build-up-plan)
- [新加坡第二艘MRCV下水](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/st-engineering-launches-second-mrcv-for-republic-of-singapore-navy/)
- [印度海军INS Malvan服役](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/indian-navy-commissions-ins-malvan-the-2nd-of-mahe-class-asw-swc/)
- [陆战队推行提前退役计划应对预算压力](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/23/marines-offered-early-separations-to-meet-budget-constraints)

印太地区海军建设持续升温，RIMPAC的实战化演练为盟友协同作战提供重要参考，同时美国陆战队因预算削减弱化兵力规模值得关注。
海军与印太.en:
Naval developments are accelerating across the Indo-Pacific and Europe. RIMPAC 2026’s sinking exercise highlighted allied precision-strike integration, while Singapore launched a second Multi-Role Combat Vessel and Italy cut steel for a second FREMM EVO frigate. Taiwan received a new coast guard cutter as its fleet modernization continues. The Marine Corps, facing budget pressure, is offering early separations.

- [RIMPAC 2026 SINKEX Highlights Expanding Allied Anti-Ship Capabilities](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/rimpac-2026-sinkex-allied-anti-ship-missile-strikes/)
- [ST Engineering Launches Second MRCV for Republic of Singapore Navy](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/st-engineering-launches-second-mrcv-for-republic-of-singapore-navy/)
- [Taiwan Receives Latest Coast Guard Cutter from $1.3B Fleet Build-up Plan](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/23/taiwan-receives-latest-coast-guard-cutter-from-1-3b-fleet-build-up-plan)
- [Fincantieri Cuts Steel for Second Italian Navy FREMM EVO Frigate](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/fincantieri-cuts-steel-second-italian-navy-fremm-evo-frigate/)
- [Marines Offered Early Separations to Meet Budget Constraints](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/23/marines-offered-early-separations-to-meet-budget-constraints)

**Signal:** Allied navies are simultaneously modernizing and conducting large-scale exercises while the US Marine Corps is forced to shed personnel—this tension between ambition and resources will shape future force structure debates.

科技产品.zh:
科技产品领域今日聚焦平台经济调整与监管冲突。Patreon裁员20%反映内容平台在AI时代的成本重构；欧盟对Google开出10亿欧元罚单，数字市场法案威力初显；FCC主席打压媒体言论自由引发争议。此外，LG显示器通过Windows Update预装McAfee广告事件暴露系统漏洞。

* [Patreon裁员20%](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/patreon-lays-off-off-20-of-its-workforce/)：核心业务强劲但需调整，AI正改变商业模式。
* [Google被欧盟罚10亿](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/google-hit-with-1-billion-in-fines-as-eu-braces-for-trump-battle/)：DMA第三次重拳，欧盟与特朗普政府博弈升温。
* [LG/McAfee广告植入](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/microsoft-responds-to-lg-monitors-installing-mcafee-ads-on-windows/)：微软回应，用户警惕硬件厂商的广告推送。
* [Meta退出清洁能源协议](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/meta-drops-out-of-a-major-clean-energy-pact-as-its-natural-gas-buildout-accelerates/)：天然气扩张加速，环保承诺与商业现实冲突。
* [Mobileye CEO离职](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/mobileye-ceo-amnon-shashua-to-step-aside-as-company-pushes-into-robotaxis-robotics/)：转向董事长，公司押注Robotaxi。

收束：科技巨头在监管与市场压力下纷纷调整战略，消费者需警惕硬件厂商利用系统权限的广告植入趋势。

AI.zh:
AI领域呈现冰火两重天：Google DeepMind士气低迷反映内部困局，AMD推出Helios机架系统强势挑战Nvidia硬件霸权；而就业影响方面，Adecco集团认为AI不会导致失业，但安全研究界抱怨AI护栏阻碍漏洞挖掘。MIT研究指出逼真AI视频正在摧毁公众对真实视频的信任。

* [Google AI士气低落](https://www.axios.com/2026/07/23/googles-deep-mind-ai-model-race)：内部研发遇挫，人才流失加剧。
* [AMD Helios机架系统](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/amd-takes-on-nvidia-with-its-helios-ai-rack-scale-system/)：直接对标Nvidia，年底发货。
* [AI不会导致失业](https://www.reuters.com/business/ai-will-not-trigger-employment-collapse-staffing-company-adecco-group-says-2026-07-23/)：Adecco集团基于招聘数据给出审慎乐观判断。
* [AI护栏阻碍安全研究](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/how-ai-guardrails-are-impeding-the-work-of-offensive-cybersecurity-researchers/)：OpenAI与Anthropic的防护机制影响漏洞挖掘。
* [AI视频破坏信任](https://www.media.mit.edu/publications/seeing-is-not-believing/)：MIT媒体实验室发现超真实AI视频引发公众怀疑一切。

收束：AI技术迭代加速，但社会信任、监管合规与商业伦理的挑战日益突出，开源模型与封闭平台的博弈将决定下一阶段格局。

HackNews社区动态.zh:
社区今日围绕开源替代、技术考古与AI伦理展开热议。Plex的商业化蔓延促使大量用户转向Jellyfin；Visual 6502模拟器与98.css UI设计勾起怀旧热潮；而一篇关于AI导致灭绝未来的分类论文引发深度讨论，另一篇关于ATProto去中心化协议的文章获得138分。

* [从Plex到Jellyfin](https://reprodev.com/the-corporate-creep-of-plex-why-it-may-be-time-to-move-to-jellyfin-and-the-open-source-reality/)：43分讨论，社区对封闭平台的厌倦。
* [Visual 6502模拟器](http://visual6502.org/JSSim/index.html)：70分，经典芯片的交互式仿真。
* [98.css复古UI](https://jdan.github.io/98.css/#status-bar)：348分，Windows 98风格CSS库引爆怀旧。
* [AI灭绝未来分类](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09369)：65分，论文系统化梳理AI可能导致人类灭绝的路径。
* [ATProto协议构建](https://lukekanies.com/writing/building-on-atproto/)：138分，探讨Bluesky背后的去中心化协议。

收束：社区在怀旧与技术自主之间寻找平衡，AI风险讨论从恐慌走向结构化分类，去中心化协议获开发者持续关注。

汽车.zh:
汽车行业今日迎来电动化冲刺与安全隐忧。丰田罕见承认“无法生存”并押注电动Corolla，Volvo EX60续航突破330英里，传统巨头转型决心加大；Tesla门把手问题触发美国安全法规制定，Massachusetts推出V2G激励政策，电动车安全细节与电网互动成为新课题。

* [丰田警告无法生存](https://electrek.co/2026/07/23/toyota-warns-cannot-survive-bets-on-next-gen-corolla-ev/)：全球最畅销车型电动化成为生死之战。
* [Volvo EX60续航330英里](https://electrek.co/2026/07/23/volvos-midsize-ev-suv-delivers-more-range-330-miles/)：EPA预估里程，成为沃尔沃最长续航EV。
* [Tesla门把手安全规则](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/23/teslas-door-handles-may-spur-new-u-s-safety-rules/)：多起致命事故引发NHTSA调查，可能出台新规。
* [Massachusetts V2G付费](https://electrek.co/2026/07/23/massachusetts-ev-drivers-battery-power-v2g/)：EV车主向电网回馈电力可获激励，V2G商业化迈出一步。
* [BYD Denza Z9 GT欧洲发布](https://electrek.co/2026/07/23/byd-launches-denza-z9-gt-ev-europe-the-uk-3x-price/)：中国豪华品牌以3倍国内价格进军欧洲。

收束：传统车企转型进入深水区，电动车安全与能源互动成为新的竞争维度，中国品牌加速出海对欧美市场形成压力。

足球.en:
The football desk is a mix of major transfer developments, managerial changes, and other sports that slipped into the feed. The headline story is Manchester City's record £116m signing of Elliot Anderson, a 23-year-old England midfielder who was a key part of England's World Cup squad. Arsenal are preparing a £70m offer for Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes, signaling an aggressive summer. Italy's national team approached Carlo Ancelotti before opening talks with Pep Guardiola, a long-term strategy shift. Jermain Defoe left his first managerial role at National League side Woking after just four months and nine matches, citing an 'eye-opening experience'. Aston Villa face a challenge in the Champions League after losing Morgan Rogers and Youri Tielemans, while Unai Emery looks to rebuild. Meanwhile, 15-year-old JJ Gabriel could make his senior Manchester United debut in a friendly against Rosenborg. Outside football, darts star Luke Littler continued his World Matchplay title defence with a stunning 16-7 win over Josh Rock, averaging 109.57. The Commonwealth Games opened in Glasgow with a royal Tardis appearance. Anthony Joshua appeared relaxed ahead of his comeback fight in Albania. Lewis Hamilton expressed belief that Ferrari can win the 2026 F1 title, while George Russell is optimistic about Mercedes' engine fixes. Scottie Scheffler bounced back from Open putting woes with a 65 at the 3M Open. Rugby league: Hull KR came from 12 points down to beat Hull FC 34-20. Cricket: Jos Buttler and Liam Dawson had a fielding mix-up in The Hundred.

This desk is a mixed bag of football transfers, managerial moves, and non-football events; the primary signal for football fans is the escalating transfer spending by Premier League clubs and the managerial uncertainty at Italy's helm.

羽毛球.en:
Badminton news is dominated by the 2026 China Open in Changzhou, where Chinese shuttlers enjoyed a strong second round with 12 wins and 2 losses. The standout performance came from Chen Yufei, who saved four match points to reverse India's Saina Nehwal in a 90-minute three-game thriller, advancing to the quarterfinals. Top men's singles player Shi Yuqi advanced to the semifinals of the Malaysia Open 2026 after a clash with Anders Antonsen, though the match report is from a third-party aggregator. Additional headlines from Sina Sports and BWF World Badminton Federation cover general event updates.

- [Chen Yufei saves 4 match points to advance at China Open](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOejR1ZF9nOHFTdVhmYXJodTlic0pNNHBpWEZpbzl5dUs0bnlycEEtSWk5S0Vic0ZRSTdFRFNTd3JTUDJ1Z05KeDZ3TDhfRGhtOHNYREVMM3czNEhNak54bFdpaF82a2hma0lYbHlybHB3UThhNTZKRmlFeUJZdWRtdnFmaGxSN1FOWXpOWHpqbFE)

Chinese fans have reason to be optimistic as Chen Yufei's resilience and the overall team depth suggest strong medal prospects at the upcoming World Championships.

篮球.en:
Basketball news is centered on the departure of Zhu Fangyu as general manager of Guangdong Southern Tigers after three consecutive CBA championships. Multiple Chinese media outlets confirm that Zhu has completed his handover and is likely to take a GM role with an NBL team, though a return to CBA is not ruled out. Commentary praises Zhu's contributions to Guangdong and Chinese basketball, while also noting that the team's underwhelming results despite heavy spending ultimately led to leadership changes involving both Zhu and coach Du Feng. Separately, former NBA player Deron Williams speculated on a show that LeBron James might return to the Miami Heat, citing weather preferences. A video analysis discusses how Cleveland can limit Jalen Brunson's offense and features Dillon Brooks trash-talking Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

- [Zhu Fangyu leaves Guangdong GM role](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQOEZGVElKd1VyaE5TNExZY1dPZWNnMkVwcWxyLUEtZ2IyTlRzQXZLemg2eXA0azR2U3lqR3k2eEVIaW9lMk5GUjNlOVlGS2hYcEd4Q1lmWjVydngxbVFmenZ4ODNNNzh3cXhkSEZlQTV2UDJFZ3ZNSnZDYVJXTWgtNDR4UUE)

The Chinese basketball landscape is undergoing a significant reshuffle with Zhu's exit, potentially affecting player recruitment and team dynamics. LeBron James rumors add offseason intrigue but remain speculative.

虎扑社区动态.en:
Two stories dominate the Hupu community feed. The first is Manchester City's record £116m signing of Elliot Anderson, which has sparked extensive debate among Chinese football fans about the Premier League arms race and City's dominance. The second is a viral discussion across Zhihu and Hupu criticizing the Chinese film 'Eight Immortals' (八仙), though this is not a sports-related topic, it reflects the community's broader cultural interests. No basketball-specific community discussions were captured in the feed beyond the previously covered Zhu Fangyu and LeBron topics that appeared in the basketball desk.

- [Man City signs Anderson for £116m](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNU0ZxdWJjNVRjSWt1eFBoRWdrZFJvWHhGUy0zUWtrT0prNW1RWUx0bzJsbGZPVWYzVUFiRnFVTmNhLUt4bEhuMWYycUxXRWY2LUJzc2puazJCZW9iRVlTeXFzbkZvcXdsc1dVX1FaX3lLQkJkaXZ0enlNbGtRVDd2Y3hPZUN6RlJFa3U5cjc4UjcxcXBybEdHOVdzTVg4SmMyT01aU1ZDc2RhMW1IOHFyTC1JZw)

The Hupu community is currently engaged more in football transfer buzz than native basketball topics, with the Anderson deal dominating discussions. The film criticism thread indicates a crossover interest beyond pure sports.

日韩.zh: 今日韩剧和综艺物料密集释出，从《新兵4》黑色喜剧到《工作明天见》的浪漫化学反应，再到《公寓工作》中池晟曝光供暖费腐败，IP衍生与老戏骨撑场并行。然而**ifeye曼谷演唱会最后一刻取消**（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857083wpp/ifeyes-bangkok-concert-cancelled-at-last-minute)）成为最大变数，暴露海外演出运营风险。此外，**朴恩斌宣布出道30周年粉丝演唱会巡演**（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857043wpp/park-eun-bin-announces-2026-fan-concert-tour-eunbin-note-euniverse)），**aespa日本发行新专辑**（[Aju Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5aVS03R0hjRFdfUWlmalVMc0tDTTFrdkNyUjBheF9zYlBkOGU2aHExcXdEbk1JQTJ6Q1JfOHdLbU4wdF9zbWVNMzNZcWVoUnlnVE9vbGRpRdIBV0FVX3lxTE5aVS03R0hjRFdfUWlmalVMc0tDTTFrdkNyUjBheF9zYlBkOGU2aHExcXdEbk1JQTJ6Q1JfOHdLbU4wdF9zbWVNMzNZcWVoUnlnVE9vbGRpRQ)），以及**《空间年糕》衍生综艺**（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856992wpp/watch-lee-eun-ji-mimi-lee-young-ji-and-an-yu-jin-work-hard-at-a-rice-cake-shop-in-new-variety-show-space-rice-cake-teaser)）首秀预告，共同构成韩流“内容大爆炸”的一天。**收束判断**：ifeye事件或将促使韩方对东南亚演出合约审核更严格，而成熟IP（如《新兵》系列）的持续开发证明军事题材网漫改编仍有市场。
日韩.en:
Korean entertainment is bustling with new drama trailers, concert cancellations, and album releases. The return of **"New Recruit 4"** brings the military comedy back, while **ifeye**'s Bangkok concert cancellation raises questions about organizer reliability. Meanwhile, **aespa** dropped a new album in Japan, and **Park Eun Bin** announced a fan concert tour for her 30th debut anniversary.

- ["New Recruit 4" teaser shows Kim Min Ho, Kim Dong Jun, Kim Hyun Kyu returning for more military absurdity.](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856922wpp/watch-kim-min-ho-kim-dong-jun-kim-hyun-kyu-and-more-return-for-another-round-of-military-life-in-new-recruit-4-teaser)
- [Stars of "A Bona Fide Killer" (Kong Hyo Jin) tease the upcoming action drama about a working mother with a lethal job.](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857129wpp/a-bona-fide-killer-stars-dish-on-what-to-look-forward-to-in-upcoming-drama)
- [ifeye's Bangkok concert cancelled last minute due to organizer-side circumstances.](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857083wpp/ifeyes-bangkok-concert-cancelled-at-last-minute)
- [aespa releases new album in Japan, expanding their global footprint.](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5aVS03R0hjRFdfUWlmalVMc0tDTTFrdkNyUjBheF9zYlBkOGU2aHExcXdEbk1JQTJ6Q1JfOHdLbU4wdF9zbWVNMzNZcWVoUnlnVE9vbGRpRdIBV0FVX3lxTE5aVS03R0hjRFdfUWlmalVMc0tDTTFrdkNyUjBheF9zYlBkOGU2aHExcXdEbk1JQTJ6Q1JfOHdLbU4wdF9zbWVNMzNZcWVoUnlnVE9vbGRpRQ)
- [Park Eun Bin announces 2026 fan concert tour "EUNBIN NOTE: EUNiverse" starting September.](https://www.soompi.com/article/1857043wpp/park-eun-bin-announces-2026-fan-concert-tour-eunbin-note-euniverse)

**Closing signal:** Expect more drama previews and possibly rescheduled ifeye dates; the K-drama season is heating up with multiple high-profile premieres.

欧美.zh: 欧美新闻关键词是“突发与悲喜”。**Chris Anne Affleck去世**（[THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/chris-anne-affleck-dead-ben-affleck-casey-affleck-mother-1236655678/)）让好莱坞失去一位低调的“影坛母亲”；**Jon Bon Jovi因鼻窦炎中断MSG演出**（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jon-bon-jovi-abruptly-ends-msg-show-vocal-issues-reschedule-1237002327/)）暴露老牌乐队巡演的体力危机。**Charli XCX新专辑发行**（[Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/charli-xcx-new-album-music-fashion-film-here-1235597706/)）占据乐坛话题中心。更令人不安的是**D4vd案件中订购尸袋等细节曝光**（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4g4lyze30vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)），以及**《了不起的麦瑟尔夫人》布景师Mary Kate Golding被刺身亡**（[THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/mary-kate-golding-dead-stabbed-marvelous-mrs-maisel-set-1236655637/)）。此外，**《生化危机》新片**（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/zach-cregger-austin-abrams-resident-evil-film-interview-1237002306/)）和**《斯图尔特未能拯救宇宙》衍生剧**（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/stuart-fails-to-save-the-universe-title-sequence-danny-elfman-1236979832/)）在SDCC上造势。**收束判断**：演出市场风险与艺人健康问题再次被摆上台面；D4vd案件将对年轻偶像的公众形象造成毁灭性打击。
欧美.en:
Western entertainment this cycle is dominated by a concert mishap and a major album release. Jon Bon Jovi ended his MSG show early due to a sinus infection, while Charli XCX unveiled her post-Brat album. Comic-Con saw Na Hong-Jin debut alien film "Hope," and the industry mourned the deaths of Chris Anne Affleck and set decorator Mary Kate Golding.

- [Jon Bon Jovi abruptly ends MSG concert, plans reschedule after sinus infection.](https://deadline.com/2026/07/jon-bon-jovi-abruptly-ends-msg-show-vocal-issues-reschedule-1237002327/) [Also on Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bon-jovi-abruptly-ends-msg-concert-sinus-infection-1235598245/)
- [Charli XCX releases "Music, Fashion, Film," calling it creatively rewarding to avoid repetition.](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/charli-xcx-releases-music-fashion-film-album-1236655613/)
- [Na Hong-Jin brings "Hope" to Comic-Con with Hoyeon; footage praised.](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/na-hong-jin-comic-con-hope-footage-hoyeon-1236819530/)
- [Chris Anne Affleck, mother of Ben and Casey, dies at 83.](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/chris-anne-affleck-dead-ben-affleck-casey-affleck-mother-1236655678/)
- [Mary Kate Golding, 'The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel' set decorator, dies at 34 in stabbing.](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/mary-kate-golding-dead-stabbed-marvelous-mrs-maisel-set-1236655637/)

**Closing signal:** Bon Jovi's tour recovery and Charli XCX's album chart performance will be closely watched, while Comic-Con continues to shape upcoming film buzz.

中国.zh: 今日中国娱乐呈现“新旧交融”格局。**中国首部AI长片获证上线爱奇艺**（[手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1xOTN3QWd4RmRvY1JLTzNlVGNiMnlfT1NtV01LOURjUm1zYW1HZHlaQVV1NGRuT3BkOENES0dxSUpiZFRkRU1CemczMWhYVVFHMjdGMGVqZFR0XzNHWmItQi1R)）堪称里程碑，标志着AI影视从概念走向商业化。**闫闯吐槽“明星参赛致安保升级”** 引发中国超级跑车锦标赛官方回应（[凤凰网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE1tZjRvWE8zYVV4aERwa3BHczNKSmhVYklOQzl3Y1pzNGg3cm9OcWxvaHpiZUM1VzFLaUNvWEtVeWZIQzFqMzNJUnBFVHQ)），折射公众对明星特权的不满。**BLACKPINK Lisa纪录片《Always Lalisa》受邀多伦多电影节**（[中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE80Yndjd2NCQlhoSDlLSlFHcXU1bE5ObEdWcWk5YkdRWlVCWW5iSnQyaUFMVFk1eTlkbnFVeFg1ZzFQMzQzMG1xYlpLQnhYVjc1QmxRcjBqbER1TlU)），巩固其国际影响力。另据**《世界新闻网》报道**，中国影视圈天价片酬缩水逾七成（[世界新聞網](https://news.google.)，行业泡沫加速消退。**收束判断**：AI影视需解决内容原创性与伦理问题，而“明星特权”争议持续发酵，体育与娱乐的边界管理将成为公共议题。
中国.en:
China's entertainment industry is embracing technological and cultural shifts: the country's first AI-generated feature film was approved for iQiyi, and traditional opera is finding new life on screen. Meanwhile, controversy erupted over celebrity participation in a supercar race causing security upgrades, and the Miss World China finals crowned a new winner.

- [中国首部AI长片获证上线爱奇艺, marking a new phase for AI film industrialisation.](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1xOTN3QWd4RmRvY1JLTzNlVGNiMnlfT1NtV01LOURjUm1zYW1HZHlaQVV1NGRuT3BkOENES0dxSUpiZFRkRU1CemczMWhYVVFHMjdGMGVqZFR0XzNHWmItQi1R)
- [第74届世界小姐中国区总决赛落幕, Yan Jiexin takes the crown with a focus on empowering women.](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1tcXNCLWtUQTh0MkdwZDRiT09wbk8wWW1ES2JEcXYzSE8tdEF3Z1RyR1JEX1RUYWVnLXNmNVhWdFpvclEtQUYtQk5BUEZHUUd4V3dvMU11dUN0Z0k)

- [戏曲人拥抱荧屏银幕, traditional opera actors embrace film and TV, revitalising the art form.](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE5nbnA3eFBMRDJEckFVRjN4NGdaN0plMUlUUWJWUTRCQ3ZhejJVREJGT3lPMy1zWGJaOU5SYmUzd0JncnhyRUpobklsSlJtTDlBVFFTTHJvU0Q1VnlsMWhlZ0hYRV9aZw)

**Closing signal:** The AI film's box office and the racing controversy's outcome will shape industry discourse; the integration of traditional culture with modern media continues.

微博社区动态.en:
